rule: PREREG_R7 5.3 / 5.4 (round 6's 5.4 for the 23 incumbent episodes): a candidate c (screen or reuse) is S-eligible iff its export is ok, it has 3 ok official runs, none flagged by the own-input gate (5.1), and own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 2 of its 3 runs; cons_S(c) = float64 mean of its 3 variant-B consensus AUCs; ties everywhere: lower population variance of the 3 consensus AUCs, lower mean consensus MPPE, job name. 23 incumbent episodes: finalist = the S-eligible c with the highest cons_S(c) among those with cons_S(c) >= m_P_frozen(e) + 0.01 (exact floats), except a reused candidate whose round-6 phase-F verdict against the same incumbent was 'no replacement' (ep12_raw_37575, ep13_raw_44922); otherwise no finalist. 7 STRICT episodes: finalists = the two highest-ranked S-eligible candidates by cons_S (rank 1, rank 2 = its fallback; one if only one is S-eligible); if none is S-eligible, the two highest by (floor_S desc, cons_S desc) among candidates with an ok export and 3 ok, unflagged runs, marked fallback_unconfirmed_S; if none has 3 ok, unflagged runs, the episode halts.

why_not: reused round-6 finalist with the phase-F verdict 'no replacement' against the same incumbent (PREREG_R7 5.4): not a finalist again
